       id: homebrew/core/sops
+    - name: showcert
+      desc: X.509 TLS certificate reader and creator
+      homepage: https://github.com/yaroslaff/showcert
+      recommended: true
+      info:
+        showcert is a tool for reading and creating X.509 TLS certificates. It provides
+        a simple interface for inspecting certificate information and generating certificates
+        for testing and development purposes.
+      id: homebrew/core/showcert
+    - name: testssl
+      desc: Tool which checks for the support of TLS/SSL ciphers and flaws
+      homepage: https://testssl.sh/
+      recommended: true
+      info:
+        testssl.sh is a command line tool that checks a server's service on any port
+        for the support of TLS/SSL ciphers, protocols and cryptographic flaws. It helps
+        identify security vulnerabilities in SSL/TLS configurations.
+      id: homebrew/core/testssl
+    - name: trivy
+      desc: Vulnerability scanner for container images, file systems, and Git repos
+      homepage: https://trivy.dev/
+      recommended: true
+      info:
+        Trivy is a comprehensive security scanner for vulnerabilities in container images,
+        file systems, and Git repositories. It detects vulnerabilities in OS packages
+        and application dependencies, helping to secure your software supply chain.
+      id: homebrew/core/trivy
